Still Thinking About Work? | Deep Night Music | 3 Hours

The laptop is closed. Your head is still at the office. Let the low strings walk you out of it.

Three hours of deep, slow night music for a mind that keeps replaying the day: heavy, resonant low notes with long silences, for winding down after work and drifting toward sleep.
